(Bild mit KI erstellt)
#newpsychedelicdeathart #codechaos

My master EQ cuts 300 Hz by 8.5 dB.

It's the first device on the master of Uhrwerk aus Blut: EQ Eight with -8.5 dB at 300 Hz, -5 dB at 650 Hz, a +6 dB low shelf at 70 Hz and high shelves at 3.2, 11 and 12 kHz.

I switched it off and measured the master output. 200 to 800 Hz got 7 to 8 dB louder, above 10 kHz it lost 16 dB, below 60 Hz 5 to 6 dB. Same limiter after it, and with the EQ on the master is even 0.6 LU quieter.

The fine work sits in a second EQ right before Pro-L 2: high-pass at 28 Hz, no move over 2.5 dB.

Uhrwerk aus Blut is out now. Part 10 next: my kick without its pitch envelope.
